children: Hooker Furnishings reported profitable results for the fiscal 2027 second quarter ended August 2, 2026, with consolidated net sales of $63.25 million and operating income of $1.28 million. The quarter included $7.9 million of tariff recoveries that reduced cost of sales and improved gross profit to $20.10 million (31.8% margin). Consolidated net income was $1.67 million for the quarter, and diluted EPS was $0.15.
Revenue: Consolidated net sales of $63.25 million for the 13 weeks ended August 2, 2026 (down from $69.24 million year-ago).
Gross profit and margin: Gross profit of $20.10 million and gross margin of 31.8% for the quarter.
Operating income: Operating income of $1.283 million for the quarter (compared with an operating loss of $0.510 million in prior-year quarter).
Net income and EPS: Net income of $1.670 million for the quarter; diluted earnings per share $0.15.

Tariff recoveries: Received $7.9 million in tariff recoveries during the quarter (approximately $4.3 million reduced cost of sales and $0.2 million interest income; $1.8 million recorded as inventory reduction).

Sales trends: Consolidated net sales declined 8.7% in the quarter and 5.5% year-to-date versus prior-year periods; Hooker Branded sales decreased 4.5% in the quarter driven by lower unit volume and higher promotional discounts.
Segment performance: Hooker Branded and Domestic Upholstery led backlog growth and improved order momentum; consolidated backlog rose 6.2% year-over-year and 8.4% sequentially.

Domestic Upholstery: Benefited from growth in private-label and outdoor furnishings and saw gross margin expansion supported by tariff recoveries, lower imported-material costs, and improved overhead absorption.

All Other / Hospitality: Experienced softer demand and timing-related project activity, producing a second-quarter operating loss but profitability for the first six months due to front-loaded shipments.

Capital allocation and liquidity: Cash and cash equivalents increased to $18.66 million at quarter-end; $24.0 million of operating cash used to repay debt, pay dividends, repurchase shares (92,357 shares repurchased year-to-date under a $5 million program), and fund capex; $51.8 million of available borrowing capacity under amended loan agreement.
